verdict.rationale: SvelteKit is the official meta-framework documented on svelte.dev and positioned as Svelte's equivalent of Next/Nuxt, with SSG (adapter-static) and SPA modes. Community users describe its folder-based routing, clear server/client data loading order, and form actions. missing for 10: first-party docs excerpts that explicitly describe the routing and load/data-fetching APIs (these are evidenced mainly through community comments), and evidence of SSR maturity beyond comparisons to Next.js.
